WITH player_avg_doubles AS (
    SELECT 
        bp.player_id,
        p.bats,
        AVG(bp.double) as avg_doubles
    FROM batting_postseason bp
    JOIN player p ON bp.player_id = p.player_id
    WHERE p.bats IS NOT NULL AND p.bats != ''
    AND bp.double IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bp.player_id, p.bats
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_doubles) as overall_average
    FROM player_avg_doubles
),
with_index AS (
    SELECT 
        pad.player_id,
        pad.bats,
        pad.avg_doubles,
        pad.avg_doubles / oa.overall_average as index_val
    FROM player_avg_doubles pad
    CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
),
hand_avg_index AS (
    SELECT 
        bats,
        AVG(index_val) as hand_average_index
    FROM with_index
    GROUP BY bats
)
SELECT 
    wi.player_id,
    wi.bats,
    wi.avg_doubles,
    wi.index_val,
    wi.index_val - hai.hand_average_index as diff
FROM with_index wi
JOIN hand_avg_index hai ON wi.bats = hai.bats
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 10
